name: Soulseek
author: Viboplr
description: Search and download from the Soulseek network via a slskd daemon: ranked results, whole-album grabs, live transfer progress, finished files that play and reach your library, and a playback fallback that fetches a missing track from Soulseek.

viewHeader.subtitle: Search and download from the Soulseek network

binaryDependencies.name: roadie
binaryDependencies.reason: Optional: installs and runs slskd for you, each step after you approve it

apiUsage.reason: Talk to your slskd daemon's REST API
See whether Viboplr has Roadie, which can install slskd for you
Ask Roadie to install or start slskd (it asks you first), and read the address and key it gives Viboplr
Remember the slskd address, API key, preferences and which downloads this plugin started
Play finished Soulseek downloads straight from slskd's downloads folder
Fetch a track from Soulseek when it has no playable source of its own (the Playback fallback in Settings → Providers)
Add a finished download to a collection through Viboplr's own download modal (tags and cover art written)
Read title, artist and album out of a finished file instead of guessing from its name
Rescan your library when a download finishes inside one of your collections
Read your copy's quality before offering an upgrade, and an album's tracks to tell which ones you're missing

assistant.instructions: Fetch music from the Soulseek peer-to-peer network through the user's slskd daemon. Flow: status (connected? signed in? where do downloads land?) → search (a real network search, ~5-30s; results are ranked best-first and carry an id) → download with one or more result ids. A download sits in another user's upload queue — it can take minutes or hours — so watch it with list_downloads rather than waiting. download is a real transfer the user's daemon performs: only download what the user actually asked for. Finished files play from the Downloads tab, and land in the library automatically when slskd's downloads folder is inside a collection. Upgrading a library track to a better copy, two ways: (a) interactive — search with upgradeFor=<library track id> (only files that beat the copy in hand), let the user pick, download, watch list_downloads until the row has a uri; (b) automatic — upgrade with the track id (this plugin searches, downloads and checks the file itself), watch list_upgrades until state is ready. Either way the finished file's uri goes to Viboplr's replace_track_file, which stages it and shows current vs new; replace only after the user says yes.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Connection state (unconfigured / unreachable / unauthorized / disconnected / connecting / ready), the Soulseek username, slskd version, whether slskd shares anything, and where finished downloads land

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Soulseek network. Slow (5-30s, one search at a time). Returns ranked candidates: id, user, filename, folder, quality (format, bitrate, lossless), size, duration, and availability (free slot / queue length / upload speed). Feed ids to download

query.description: Free text — artist, album and/or track. Soulseek matches on file and folder names

durationSecs.description: Expected track length; candidates more than 5s off are dropped (catches mislabeled files)

upgradeFor.description: Library track id of a LOCAL file to upgrade: query and duration default to that track, and only results that beat its quality are returned. A download from this search is stamped as that track's upgrade

showAll.description: With upgradeFor: return every result, each flagged better true/false

tools.name: download
tools.description: Queue one or more search results (by id, all from the same search) in slskd. A real download the user's daemon performs — download only what the user asked for. Returns the queued files; progress via list_downloads

ids.description: Result ids from search. Pass every file of a folder to grab a whole album

tools.name: list_downloads
tools.description: The downloads slskd is managing: file, user, phase (requested / queued / starting / downloading / succeeded / failed / cancelled), progress (0-1), place in the other user's queue, speed, error, upgradeFor (the library track it was fetched to upgrade), and — once finished and slskd runs on this computer — the local path and a uri for Viboplr's replace_track_file / download_plugin_track

tools.name: upgrade
tools.description: The automatic Upgrade (the Upgrades tab): action=start looks for a better copy of a LOCAL library track in the background — search, pick, download from a sharer, then check the real bitrate — at the user's Upgrade target setting. Also retry, take_alternative (accept the best better copy that missed the target) and remove. Never replaces anything itself

tools.name: list_upgrades
tools.description: Every automatic upgrade: state (searching / downloading / checking / ready / alternative / none / failed / replaced), message, the library copy's quality, live download progress, and — when ready — the checked file's quality and the uri for Viboplr's replace_track_file
